designSummary: Prospective observational study; logistic regression of 30-day infection on full compliance with six covariates.
sampleSize: About 380 resections a year with 14 percent infection give about 53 infections a year. If 40 percent of cases are fully compliant and the true adjusted odds ratio is near 0.6, one year gives about 50 percent power at two-sided alpha 0.05; 24 months (about 760 resections and 106 infections) gives about 77 percent power and about 18 events per covariate. The 12-month report is descriptive only.
primaryAnalysis: Logistic regression of infection within 30 days on full compliance, adjusted for emergency status, contamination class, stoma formation, diabetes, body mass index 35 or more and operation over 180 minutes; results also shown separately for elective and emergency cases.
secondaryAnalysis: Element-level compliance described without element-level effect estimates; deep or organ-space infection; sensitivity analysis counting unreached patients as infected and as not infected.
missingData: Missing covariates handled by multiple imputation with 20 imputations; patients not reached after three attempts and a clinic check are reported and bounded in the sensitivity analysis.
multiplicity: One primary association; secondary outcomes with confidence intervals only.
software: R; analysis plan fixed before the first form is completed.
summary: Twenty-four months give about 77 percent power for an odds ratio near 0.6; one year would give about 50 percent.
